summary: Verified login works end-to-end after backend/.env was restored. Backend health OK (/api/auth/demo-status returns demo_mode=true). All 4 one-click demo buttons (admin/partner/customer/merchant) and manual OTP flow (+919000000000 / 123456) sign in and route to the correct panel which renders dashboard content.

issues: Multiple recharts console warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - cosmetic, likely transient on initial mount but noisy in console

critical_code_review_comments: backend/.env is critical for startup (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET). Consider: (a) failing startup with a clear error message rather than KeyError, (b) committing a .env.example and documenting required keys, (c) adding a container-level healthcheck so a missing .env surfaces immediately rather than via 502s on every /api call.

On /login, if a valid token already exists in localStorage the page auto-redirects to the active panel. This is correct behavior but testing agents must clear storage between demo-button tests to avoid false negatives.
Recharts initial render warnings should be fixed by giving ResponsiveContainer parents an explicit min height/width or an aspect ratio.
test_credentials: Demo OTP 123456 for all. Admin +919000000000, Partner +919000000003, Customer +919000000004, Merchant +919000000002. One-click demo buttons on /login.
seed_data_creation: None (seed() ran on backend startup; existing demo accounts reused).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow fully verified post .env restoration. Verified via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://reschedule-ring-fix.preview.emergentagent.com). Note: /login auto-redirects when a token is in localStorage - clear storage between tests. OTP input is 6 segmented boxes (input[inputmode="numeric"] with maxlength=1) - fill each box individually, not a single input. Phone input selector: input[placeholder*="mobile" i].
rca of the issue: RCA: /app/backend/.env was missing/empty, so FastAPI startup raised KeyError 'MONGO_URL' and the backend returned 502 on every /api call, breaking login. Fix: recreated backend/.env with MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017, DB_NAME=azoapp_database, JWT_SECRET, CORS_ORIGINS=*. Backend restarted and seed() repopulated demo accounts. Verified send-otp returns dev_otp 123456 and verify-otp returns a valid JWT for admin/partner/customer/merchant demo numbers; frontend demo buttons and manual OTP flow all route correctly.
